title: CJP Announces 'Mumbai Chalo' Assembly at Shivaji Park Gate 6, 4 pm Oct 2
detail: Despite the police denial, the Cockroach Janta Party announced participants should assemble at Shivaji Park Gate No. 6 at 4 p.m. on Oct 2 for its 'Mumbai Chalo' protest demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation. Dipke said a Jail Bharo Andolan would follow on Gandhi Jayanti if protest rights are restricted.

media.caption: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke announces Mumbai Chalo protest.
